estimator.input_token_rule: ceil(text characters / 4) plus declared fixed overheads

estimator.cost: estimated tokens multiplied by the matching versioned pricing entry

baseline.model_policy: all cases use configured model gpt-5.6-terra
baseline.context_policy: full declared context and whole-document estimator overhead

optimized.model_policy: clarification and controlled terminal paths use gpt-5.6-luna; diagnostic paths use gpt-5.6-terra
optimized.context_policy: relevant chunks and generated-context relevant items only
